title: What if India had never invented zero?
description:
What if the world had never discovered zero? 🤯

From mathematics and science to computers and modern technology, zero changed the way humanity understands numbers.

And one of its most important mathematical developments has deep roots in India.

Sometimes, the most powerful invention is a number that represents nothing.

Do you think zero is the greatest mathematical invention ever?
pinnedComment: Do you think zero is the greatest mathematical invention ever?
